sql.ahj.utility.list.all: SELECT au.id, au.name, au.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area, s.id AS state_id, s.abbreviation AS state, au.active FROM brs.ahj_utility au LEFT JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = au.metro_area_id LEFT JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON sa.id = ma.sales_area_id LEFT JOIN flow.state s ON s.id = sa.state_id ORDER BY au.name
sql.ahj.utility.simple.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_utility SET name = :utilityName, active = :active, metro_area_id = :metroAreaId, date_updated = now() WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_utility SET name = :utilityName, active = :active, metro_area_id = :metroAreaId, ac_disconnect_required = :acDisconnectRequired, meter_can_taps_allowed = :meterCanTapsAllowed, pv_production_meter_required = :pvProductionMeterRequired, pv_ac_swap_locations = :pvacSwapLocations, utility_warning_labels_override = :utilityWarningLabelsOverride, date_updated = now(), timelines_and_stages = :timelinesAndStages, regulated_by = :regulatedBy, monthly_facility_charge = :monthlyFacilityCharge, population_of_service = :populationOfService, net_metering_rate = :netMeteringRate, rebate_rates = :rebateRates, utility_rate_notes = :utilityRateNotes, rebate_program_type_id = :rebateProgramTypeId, rebate_program_type_other = :rebateProgramTypeOther, signature_required_prior_type_id = :signatureRequiredPriorTypeId, signature_required_prior_type_other = :signatureRequiredPriorTypeOther, signature_requested_at_type_id = :signatureRequestedAtTypeId, signature_requested_at_type_other = :signatureRequestedAtTypeOther, customer_signature_instructions = :customerSignatureInstructions, expected_approval_timeline = :expectedApprovalTimeline, customer_signature_resubmission_type_id = :customerSignatureResubmissionTypeId, customer_signature_resubmission_type_other = :customerSignatureResubmissionTypeOther, rejection_instructions = :rejectionInstructions, notes = :notes, overview_of_submission_process = :overviewOfSubmissionProcess, when_to_create_application_type_id = :whenToCreateApplicationTypeId, when_to_create_application_type_other = :whenToCreateApplicationTypeOther, submission_method_type_id = :submissionMethodTypeId, submission_method_type_other = :submissionMethodTypeOther, interconnection_fee_type_id = :interconnectionFeeTypeId, interconnection_fee_type_other = :interconnectionFeeTypeOther, submission_instructions = :submissionInstructions, utility_method_type_id = :utilityMethodTypeId, utility_method_type_other = :utilityMethodTypeOther, inspection_submission_type_id = :inspectionSubmissionTypeId, inspection_submission_type_other = :inspectionSubmissionTypeOther, utility_inspection_required_type_id = :utilityInspectionRequiredTypeId, utility_inspection_required_type_other = :utilityInspectionRequiredTypeOther, followup_method_type_id = :followupMethodTypeId, followup_method_type_other = :followupMethodTypeOther, timelines = :timelines, pto_followup_instructions = :ptoFollowupInstructions, final_completion_instructions = :finalCompletionInstructions WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.insert: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_utility(name, active, date_created, date_updated, metro_area_id) VALUES (:utilityName, true, now(), now(), :metroAreaId)
sql.ahj.utility.detailById: SELECT u.*, ma.metro_area, s.id AS "state_id", s.abbreviation AS "state", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_contact auc ON c.id = auc.ahj_contact_id WHERE auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 8 ) contacts), '[]') AS contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 4 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order ) checklist), '[]') AS submission_checklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 5 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS approval_checklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 6 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS pto_checklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 7 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS utility_inspection_checklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 6 AND apl.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS customer_signature_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 7 AND apl.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS pto_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 8 AND apl.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS pto_followup_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 9 AND apl.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS submission_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(requirements))) FROM ( WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT utility_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_utility_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 ) SELECT aur.utility_id AS "utilityId", aur.position, aur.status_id AS "statusId", ars.name status, aur.complete, aur.date_created AS "dateCreated", aur.created_by_id AS "createdById", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "createdBy", aur.date_updated AS "dateUpdated", aur.updated_by_id AS "updatedById", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "updatedBy", ar.id, ar.description, ar.requirement_type_id AS "requirementTypeId", aur.original_requirement_id AS "originalRequirementId", CASE WHEN oc.original_requirement_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "hasOpenChallenge" FROM brs.ahj_utility_requirements aur LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.utility_id = aur.utility_id AND oc.original_requirement_id = aur.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement ar ON ar.id = aur.requirement_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = aur.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = aur.updated_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = aur.status_id WHERE aur.utility_id = :id AND aur.status_id = 1 AND aur.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY aur.position) requirements ), '[]') AS utility_requirements FROM brs.ahj_utility u LEFT JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = u.metro_area_id LEFT JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON sa.id = ma.sales_area_id LEFT JOIN flow.state s ON s.id = sa.state_id WHERE u.id = :id
